summaries.zh: mount one row in the composition and every plugin card on the Web Settings plugin list page gets a bilingual (zh/en) description; it also publishes the pluginDescriptions service so other plugins can register their own descriptions.
summaries.en: mount one row in the composition and every plugin card on the Web Settings plugin list page gets a bilingual (zh/en) description; it also publishes the pluginDescriptions service so other plugins can register their own descriptions.
